subject.title: [Bug]: replay_invalid thinking-signature crashes on process restart: 3 findings from 2026-07-03

question: Should this issue be resolved by a coordinated signed-thinking replay policy that covers non-compaction restart replay and terminal-result recovery, and should the direct config-write/session-lock cascade be split into its own product decision?
rationale: The source-level replay bug is clear, but the permanent product behavior affects provider replay semantics, recovery carrier ownership, and whether trusted direct config edits should be blocked, alerted, or tolerated during active embedded prompts.

options.title: Coordinate Cluster Fix
options.body: Keep this issue open under the signed-thinking cluster, sponsor or review a targeted PR that covers non-compaction restart replay plus the terminal-result carrier, and split the config-lock behavior if it needs a separate policy call.

options.title: Replay-Only Patch
options.body: Accept a narrow fix that strips or drops older thinking on replay_invalid retry, while leaving direct config-write/session-lock behavior to a follow-up issue.

options.title: Pruning Policy First
options.body: Defer the restart-specific fix until maintainers decide whether older thinking blocks should be pruned by default across context replay.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Cluster Fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open under the signed-thinking cluster, sponsor or review a targeted PR that covers non-compaction restart replay plus the terminal-result carrier, and split the config-lock behavior if it needs a separate policy call.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh Avant has the strongest adjacent merged history on rejected-thinking replay repair and embedded attempt wiring among the likely owners identified here.
